checks: Preparatory permanent skill growth is visible in unit details and the Canvas HUD.
Canvas click selects an enemy and a naturally summoned wolf without changing the observation camera.
Mouse hover and touch tap show an effect-specific tooltip.
Buff DOM node and open tooltip survive periodic detail refresh.
Both desktop and tablet roster portraits have nonzero 40x40 click targets.
fixtureNote: Presentation fixture equips an existing Duel permanent bonus and Lycan summon skill directly, then starts the real engine and waits for natural wolf summons. It adds one ten-second stun status and increases live health only to hold an observable scene. These modified inputs are not treated as valid inventory/save fixtures or mechanics/replay acceptance; no battle results are injected. The replay-feature-smoke report separately covers valid UI-only purchasing, saves and deterministic replay.
boundaries: Desktop and tablet are Chromium viewport/touch emulation, not physical-device validation.
Timed border fractions and independent stacks are covered by the pure Buff tests.
This fixture deliberately violates the regular inventory pool and therefore can show the expected unsaved-state warning.
